strings.title: The Room with Two Numbers
strings.hint: Make separate columns for engraved key number and map unit number. Then compare the aim of the 08:43 message with the 09:18 demand.
strings.solvedText: Ziad Qandil turned Noura’s voluntary departure into detention. The meeting contradicts his denial. Old key 2 serves the west map room, which is new unit 1; all three photographed features match it. The cancellation demand reverses Noura’s documented plan and was created locally while Ziad alone occupied the office. Shared account ownership or key possession alone is insufficient, but movements, key, message and motive converge while others have independent coverage. Teams reached the west room and secured Noura. The later confirmation that her phone had been taken is not needed to solve the file.
strings.summary.text: Researcher Noura Safwat voluntarily left the main building. A later message barred her departure and demanded withdrawal of a sample-review request. This file reviews the investigation after the search ended and her safety was secured; no rescue depends on your answer. Identify who turned voluntary departure into detention and reconcile two room-numbering systems.
strings.summary.victim.name: Noura Safwat
strings.summary.victim.note: The investigation concerns responsibility and location, not her right to leave.
strings.scene.address: Coastal research station — internal service yard
strings.scene.intro: The side gate leads from the main building into an internal yard, not onto the public road. The old map room is west, the tool room east and a detached store lies between them. A new asset map does not renumber the old keys.
strings.scene.notes[0]: All three units were within the search and guarded perimeter.
strings.scene.notes[2]: Photographs establish fixed features; facial expression alone does not establish consent or coercion.
strings.evidence[0].title: Two messages, two aims
strings.evidence[0].desc:
08:43, Noura’s phone to Rasha: “I am well and left voluntarily. Do not report before 10:00; I am going to the samples committee as agreed.”
09:18, office workstation to director: “She will not leave until she cancels the review and leaves the samples. Do not contact the committee.” A photograph was attached. Noura’s phone went offline at 09:06 after her live 09:05 call; disconnection alone does not explain why.
strings.evidence[1].title: Attached room photograph
strings.evidence[1].desc: The original shows Noura and her bag in a room with a window of three vertical sections, a horizontal yellow pipe and a fixed wooden map table. The door is closed and no phone is visible. Body posture cannot establish agreement to the detention message.
strings.evidence[2].title: Old key register
strings.evidence[2].desc:
Engraved numbers: 1 = east tools; 2 = west maps; 3 = detached store.
08:58: key 2 issued to Ziad.
09:22: returned.
Emergency key with Bilal; no other issue or key cutting recorded.
strings.evidence[3].title: New asset map
strings.evidence[3].desc: Asset numbers: unit 1 = west map room; unit 2 = detached store; unit 3 = east tool room. This map inventories assets; it is not a key register. No instruction renumbered the keys.
strings.evidence[4].title: Room-feature record
strings.evidence[4].desc: Maintenance photographs from a month earlier: west — three window sections, yellow pipe, fixed map table. East — three sections but no pipe, metal rack. Detached store — two sections and yellow pipe but no table. These features were unchanged.
strings.evidence[5].title: Local workstation creation
strings.evidence[5].desc: The message was created locally at 09:16 and sent at 09:18, with no scheduling or remote access. The account is shared, but footage of every office entrance places Ziad alone inside from 09:12 to 09:20. Account ownership alone is not personal attribution.
strings.evidence[6].title: The previous night’s plan
strings.evidence[6].desc: Complete chat between Noura and Rasha: quiet departure to the west map room, Fares expected at 09:00, then the 10:00 committee to request a sample review. No ransom demand or agreement to cancel the review. The later message demands the opposite of their documented aim.
strings.evidence[7].title: Independent presence records
strings.evidence[7].desc: Rasha is on a filmed bus 08:52–09:24; minimum return travel is 12 minutes. Fares is at the permit checkpoint 08:54–09:24. Bilal is at the electrical panel with the inspector and footage 08:50–09:30, his key visible. There are no gaps permitting the suggested station movements.
strings.suspects[0].name: Ziad Qandil
strings.suspects[0].relation: Sample-batch relabelling under his responsibility was under review.
strings.suspects[0].alibi: Says he did not meet Noura after 08:30 and key 2 serves the detached store.
strings.suspects[0].statement: Perhaps she staged her absence to avoid the conference. Rasha and Bilal share the office account. I borrowed the key to unit 2 and do not recall speaking with her after the break.
strings.suspects[1].name: Rasha Nabil
strings.suspects[1].relation: Helped a secret departure; the sample review also exposes gaps in her work.
strings.suspects[1].alibi: On the town bus from 08:52 to 09:24.
strings.suspects[1].statement: I initially denied the plan to protect her privacy. She was to wait for Fares in the west map room, then attend the committee at 10:00. I supplied my log despite its exposing incomplete collection, because review was our goal.
strings.suspects[2].name: Bilal Hatem
strings.suspects[2].relation: Has an emergency key and an unauthorised scrap business.
strings.suspects[2].alibi: With the electrical inspector at the supply panel from 08:50 to 09:30.
strings.suspects[2].statement: I reported the map/key numbering confusion twice. I had the emergency key, but it stayed in the inspector’s view throughout our work. My scrap misconduct does not mean I detained Noura.
strings.suspects[3].name: Fares Tawfiq
strings.suspects[3].relation: Lied about arrival to keep his deposit.
strings.suspects[3].alibi: Stopped at the road-permit checkpoint from 08:54 to 09:24.
strings.suspects[3].statement: I said I arrived at 09:00; that was false. My permit was delayed. Noura never entered my vehicle and I received no room key. The deposit was for a committee trip.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Sakina Mahmoud
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I called Noura at 09:05. She was waiting for the car and said Ziad had found her and offered to settle matters. I heard her say, “I will not withdraw the request.” The call ended; I cannot testify to what happened next.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Tamer Sherif
strings.witnesses[1].statement: I saw Noura and Ziad by the west room around 09:00, with no visible coercion then. My invoice is timed 09:01; Ziad took a water bottle. That encounter cannot establish that everything later was voluntary.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Manal Fouad
strings.witnesses[2].statement: I issued Ziad key engraved 2 at 08:58 and received it back at 09:22. The old book calls it the west map room. I mistakenly said unit 2 in my statement, confusing it with the new map; the original entry is unchanged.
strings.folders[0].name: Doors and windows
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: 33-D1 — Doors and windows
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: Unit doors do not lock automatically; securing them from outside requires a key. Windows have fixed bars and there are no hidden passages. The main building’s side gate opens onto the internal yard, so seeing Noura there does not establish departure from the property.
strings.folders[1].name: Review request
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: 33-D2 — Review request
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: The 10:00 committee would examine the sample chain: Ziad handled batch relabelling and Rasha incomplete collection. Ziad requested a one-week delay at 07:50; Noura refused. These are grounds for review, not a prior finding of research fraud.
strings.folders[2].name: Ziad’s revised account
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: 33-D3 — Ziad’s revised account
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Confronted with the invoice, Ziad said they might have spoken briefly. He suggested someone left the message window open before he entered. The 09:16 creation record postdates his arrival, with scheduling and remote access excluded.
strings.folders[3].name: Search deployment
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: 33-D4 — Search deployment
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: At 09:32 teams covered all three units and their exits together, with no person leaving during the operation. Feature matching prioritised entry; the search was never suspended pending a puzzle answer. The player reviews this file after Noura’s safety was secured.
strings.folders[4].name: Deposit and Rasha’s log
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: 33-D5 — Deposit and Rasha’s log
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: The deposit is a documented payment for the committee trip, not extortion. Rasha supplied a log exposing her collection gaps. This does not make her faultless, but supports the review plan rather than a demand to cancel it.
strings.reports[0].title: 33-R1 — Message authentication
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[0].body: Originals were recovered from phone, server and workstation. No alteration or documented agreement to stage detention was found. The report does not infer coercion from Noura’s expression; it leaves comparison of origin, time and content to the investigation.
strings.reports[1].title: 33-R2 — Location comparison
strings.reports[1].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[1].body: The three features must match together; neither pipe alone nor window-section count alone is sufficient. Maintenance records establish that table, pipe and windows remained unchanged since the previous month’s photographs.
